slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
【你，是恶毒女配。】
【你天生坏种、诡计多端、自私自利只爱自己，因为愚蠢一次次犯下滔天大错。】
【最后伤人伤己死不瞑目，落得一个让读者大快人心的下场。】
一句一句魔音穿耳，犹如利箭扎在舒晩昭的心上。
夜晚群星点缀，溪边的火光照耀在溪水中，一抹倩影双手捂耳，可怜巴巴地碎碎念：“系统，统哥，别念了，你骂得太脏。”
舒晩昭是早产儿，从小体弱多病，但她家里有钱，父母和兄长从小对她千般宠爱，是一个名副其实的富家小千金。
未穿越前，她从未受过这种委屈。
她突然心脏病没来得及医治，死后便遇见编号为666的救赎系统。
绑定后系统小嘴一直嘚啵嘚，上嘴唇下嘴唇一碰都能把它自己毒乱码、而且舒晩昭怀疑它带点私人恩怨。
她捏耳朵，在心里回复：
【系哥，说好的做完任务我能重生呢，你怎么一直在骂，剧情呢？任务呢？我要洗白人设救赎主角来完成任务吗？】
她无法出院时，兄长怕她寂寞经常给她小说看，大部分的套路都是穿越到古代，或者小说里救赎男主之类的。
【不，你要做的是按照原剧本走。】666骂爽了，收了收宣泄的代码，给她传送大概剧情。
原主舒晩昭是卧龙宗长老之女，长老因救宗主死亡，宗主惦念原主父母的恩情，将她收入门下。
可惜这位卧龙宗主不会带孩子，过分纵容导致宗门里出现个凤雏。
凤雏凭借一己之力蠢死整个宗门。
师尊修为尽失、大师兄失去双眼、二师兄坠入魔道，小师弟更是整天寻死觅活，宗门的顶梁柱倒塌，底下弟子树倒猢狲散。
【之所以称为救赎系统，是为之后女主的出现做铺垫，你的任务是维持原主人设，走无奈恶毒卑鄙无耻的的剧情，蠢死原著的几个男主。】
【男主们混得越惨，今后女主救赎就越有意义。】

【最后几个男主在女主的救赎下修复你带来的伤痛，也不再助纣为虐，嘁哩喀喳就把你弄死了报仇雪恨。】
舒晩昭蹲在溪边，垂眸看着水面的影子。
女子肩膀瘦弱，浅红色仙裙上叮叮当当的法器点缀，像是摇钱树很是耀眼，长相和她现实中几乎一模一样。
五官精致，模样娇俏，琼鼻樱唇，完全看不出恶毒的影子。
她纤长的睫毛随着她说话而轻颤，“按照剧本走，找我不是多此一举吗？”
【是这样的，可是原主女配不想死，她觉醒出逃了。我只能去其他位面找人顶上，宿主你放心走剧情，肯定不会让你打白工，况且像你这样的年轻人就应该好好历练，毕竟这些学到手都是自己的，等你死后就能回到原来的世界和家里人团聚，而且这边还有任务完成奖励赠送你一个健康的身体。】
但凡舒晩昭上过班都会觉得有那两句有点耳熟。
来都来了，她当然不会临时退缩。
她轻眨眼睛，扫视四周。
夜晚，群星不知何时被乌云遮盖，树叶沙沙，仿佛有什么东西在靠近，大晚上她孤身一人，周围只有一团火，引来无数飞蛾。
传输的记忆中，这是她第一次出宗门历练，还没出来多久就喊累要休息，和其他弟子发生分歧。
弟子们不乐意和这位娇小姐在一起，也不惯着她直接走人。

[You are a vicious female supporting character. 】
[You are born bad, scheming, selfish and only love yourself, but you make huge mistakes again and again because of your stupidity. 】
[In the end, he hurts others and himself, and ends up with a happy ending. 】
Every sentence of the demonic sound pierced his ears, like a sharp arrow piercing Shu Mingzhao's heart.
The stars were dotted at night, and the firelight by the stream shone in the water. A beautiful figure covered her ears with her hands and muttered pitifully: "System, Brother Tong, stop reading, you are swearing too much."
Shu Mingzhao was born prematurely and was frail and sickly since she was a child. However, her family was rich, and her parents and brother had doted on her in every possible way since she was a child. She was a veritable little daughter of a wealthy family.
Before traveling through time, she had never suffered this kind of injustice.
She suddenly had a heart attack and didn't have time to get treatment. After her death, she met the salvation system numbered 666.
After being bound, the system's little mouth kept popping, and every touch of its upper and lower lips could poison it into garbled characters, and Shu Manzhao suspected that it had some personal grudges.
She pinched her ears and replied in her mind:
[Brother Xie, I promised that I would be reborn after completing the mission. Why do you keep scolding me? What about the plot? What about the mission? Do I have to whitewash the redemption protagonist to complete the mission? 】
When she could not be discharged from the hospital, her brother often read novels to her because he was afraid of her loneliness. Most of the plots were about traveling to ancient times or redeeming the male protagonist in the novel.
[No, what you have to do is follow the original script. 】666 was happy with the scolding, so he took away the cathartic code and sent her the outline of the plot.
The original owner, Shu Mingzhao, was the daughter of an elder of the Wolong Sect. The elder died while saving the sect leader. The sect owner was thinking of the kindness of the original owner's parents and took her into his sect.
It's a pity that the Wolong Sect Master doesn't know how to take care of children, and his over-indulgence led to the appearance of a phoenix in the sect.
Feng Chu single-handedly killed the entire sect.
The master has lost all his cultivation, the eldest brother has lost his eyes, the second brother has fallen into the devil's path, and the younger brother is looking for death and survival all day long. The pillars of the sect have collapsed, and the disciples below have fallen and scattered.
[The reason why it is called the redemption system is to pave the way for the subsequent emergence of the female protagonist. Your task is to maintain the character of the original protagonist, follow a helpless, vicious, despicable and shameless plot, and stupidly kill the male protagonists of the original work. 】
[The worse the male protagonists are, the more meaningful the female protagonist’s redemption will be in the future. 】
[The last few male protagonists have repaired the pain caused by you with the redemption of the female protagonist, and they no longer help the villain, and will kill you to take revenge. 】
Shu Mingzhao squatted by the stream, looking down at the shadow on the water.
The woman has thin shoulders, and the light red fairy skirt is decorated with jingling magic weapons, which is very dazzling like a money tree. She looks almost exactly like her in reality.
She has exquisite facial features, a delicate appearance, a beautiful nose and cherry lips, and there is no trace of evil at all.
Her long eyelashes trembled as she spoke, "Follow the script, wouldn't it be unnecessary to find me?"
[That’s true, but the original female protagonist didn’t want to die, so she woke up and ran away. I can only go to other planes to find someone to take over. Host, you can rest assured and follow the plot. I will definitely not let you work in vain. Besides, young people like you should practice hard. After all, these lessons are yours. After you die, you can return to your original world and reunite with your family. Moreover, there are rewards for completing tasks to give you a healthy body. 】
Anyone who has ever worked in Shu Mizhao will find those two sentences a bit familiar.
It's come, and of course she won't back down temporarily.
She blinked lightly and glanced around.
At night, the stars were obscured by dark clouds at some point, and the leaves rustled, as if something was approaching. She was alone at night, with only a fire around her, attracting countless moths.
In the transferred memory, this was her first time out of the sect for training. Not long after she came out, she complained that she was tired and wanted to rest, and she had disagreements with other disciples.
The disciples were not happy to be with this charming young lady, and they did not tolerate her and just left.
